case.name: tipo_cuenta_no_permitido
case.description: Account type PRE is not CTE, AHO or VIR: rejected with 50001 before any lookup.

case.name: orden_no_existe
case.description: The order number exists only for another company, so the lookup returns no rows (50002).

case.name: orden_no_pendiente
case.description: The order exists but its status is 'A' instead of 'P' (50003).

case.name: tarifa_empresa_comision_incluida
case.description: The company tariff (2.00, flag N) overrides the service tariff (9.00). Non-WEB channel pays the full tariff, which is added to the debit. Successful payment: the order is updated and committed.

case.name: tarifa_servicio_por_defecto_cuenta_cte
case.description: No company tariff row: the service tariff (1.50) is used with flag 'N'. CTE account type is accepted.

case.name: sin_tarifa_definida
case.description: Neither a company tariff nor a service row exists: the tariff stays NULL and becomes 0.

case.name: tarifa_empresa_valor_nulo
case.description: A company row exists with a NULL tar_valor: no fallback to the service tariff; the tariff becomes 0.

case.name: canal_web_mitad_con_redondeo
case.description: WEB channel pays half the tariff rounded to 2 decimals: 5.01 / 2 = 2.505.

case.name: servicio_nomina_sin_comision
case.description: Service NOMINA never carries a commission, even on the WEB channel with a tariff of 5.00.

case.name: comision_separada_debitada
case.description: Company tariff 3.00 with flag 'S': the order amount is debited, then a second debit of the commission is made.

case.name: comision_separada_en_cero_sin_segundo_debito
case.description: Flag 'S' but the commission is 0 (tariff 0.00): only one debit is made.

case.name: comision_separada_falla_deshace_pago
case.description: The first debit succeeds and leaves its effect, but the separate commission debit returns 1: rollback (undoing the first debit) and error 50006.

case.name: debito_falla
case.description: sp_debito returns non-zero on the main debit: rollback and error 50005.

case.name: fondos_vir_menor_al_total
case.description: VIR account with balance 99.99 and total 100.00: rejected (50004).

case.name: fondos_vir_igual_al_total
case.description: VIR account with balance exactly equal to the total (100.00): accepted.

case.name: fondos_aho_justo_en_el_margen
case.description: AHO account with balance 100.00 and total 200.00: balance + 100.00 equals the total, accepted.

case.name: fondos_aho_debajo_del_margen
case.description: AHO account with balance 99.99 and total 200.00: balance + 100.00 is below the total, rejected (50004).

quirks.behavior: `select @v = col from t where ...` leaves @v unchanged when no row matches and keeps the LAST row when several match; it never fails.
quirks.target: Keep the previous value when the query returns nothing and take the last row when it returns several; do not throw on an empty or multiple result.
quirks.probe:
declare @v int
select @v = 5
select @v = id from sysobjects where 1 = 2
select 'NXQ|select-assign-from-table|' + convert(varchar(10), @v)

quirks.behavior: A failing statement does not stop the procedure: execution goes on and the program decides with @@error and @@rowcount, which every statement resets.
quirks.target: Read the outcome of each statement right after it (rows affected, error) and continue as the program does; do not let an exception skip the code the legacy runs after the error.

quirks.behavior: Transactions nest by count (@@trancount); a ROLLBACK at any level rolls back everything and sets the count to 0.
quirks.target: Use one transaction for the whole program and roll it back entirely where the program rolls back.
quirks.probe:
begin tran
begin tran
rollback tran
select 'NXQ|nested-tran|' + convert(varchar(10), @@trancount)

quirks.behavior: Comparisons ignore trailing spaces ('a' = 'a  ') and CHAR(n) values are padded with spaces to n.
quirks.target: Compare strings without their trailing spaces and pad or trim CHAR values as the golden master shows.
